_comment_filters: OFF by default -- every alert in the channel gets forwarded. Flip enable_filters to true if it ever gets too noisy; the thresholds below only apply then.
_comment_levels: Entry/stop/targets are derived from the last price, in percent.
_comment_pacing: Rate control lives here and in the cron interval, not in filtering. The channel averages ~36 alerts/hour, so ~3 arrive per 5-minute run.
